file: One row per graded game. Read of record only: the last read Leo saved before tip.

columns.name: sport
columns.meaning: Always NBA.

columns.name: season
columns.meaning: The NBA season, for example 2026-27.

columns.name: game_date
columns.meaning: The day the game was played, in Eastern time.

columns.name: game_id
columns.meaning: ESPN's game id.

columns.name: away_team
columns.meaning: The visiting team's full name.

columns.name: home_team
columns.meaning: The home team's full name.

columns.name: start_utc
columns.meaning: Scheduled tip time.

columns.name: read_saved_utc
columns.meaning: When Leo saved the read this row uses: the last read saved before tip. Nothing written after tip is used.

columns.name: leo_win_prob_away
columns.meaning: Leo's chance that the away team wins.

columns.name: leo_win_prob_home
columns.meaning: Leo's chance that the home team wins.

columns.name: leo_margin_home
columns.meaning: Leo's own margin: positive means Leo has the home team winning by that many, negative the away team.

columns.name: leo_total
columns.meaning: Leo's projected combined score. Empty when the saved card does not match the read of record.

columns.name: final_away
columns.meaning: The away team's final score.

columns.name: final_home
columns.meaning: The home team's final score.

columns.name: overtime
columns.meaning: Whether the game went to overtime.

columns.name: pick_side
columns.meaning: The team Leo picked to win (a Leo Pick: 60% or more with Leo at a price better than -230). Empty when there was no pick.

columns.name: pick_result
columns.meaning: The Leo Pick's result. Empty when there was no pick.

columns.name: pick_units
columns.meaning: Units won or lost on a one unit Leo Pick at the price it was graded on. The price itself is not in the file.

columns.name: leo_right_winner
columns.meaning: Whether the team Leo gave 50% or more won.

columns.name: miss_reason
columns.unit: injury_input, market_knew, overtime, blowout, variance, model_error or empty
columns.meaning: Why the game counts as a miss, the same reason the results page shows (ndhorizon.com/nba/results/). Empty when the game is not a miss.

columns.name: model_version
columns.meaning: The Leo model that made the read.
